definition: a device that converts signals into sounds
description: Four shots of things shaking. A phone with a cracked screen buzzes on the boards of a wooden deck. A massage gun is pressed against a man's bare bicep and hammers into the muscle. A tracked machine's hydraulic breaker punches into gravel and asphalt, throwing up small stones. Finally a big black club speaker box hangs in a dark venue with dancers behind it, and a glass of water on the table in front of it ripples with the bass.
